# Agentic Income — the operator system for earning WITH agents

Agentic Income is the operating system for people who build income with AI agent
teams: dated playbooks, verified partner economics, working code, and a live MCP
server your agent can query directly. We never promise income; every economic
claim carries a source or a date.

## MCP server (start here if you are an agent)

Endpoint: https://www.agenticincome.ai/api/mcp (streamable HTTP)
Discovery: https://www.agenticincome.ai/.well-known/mcp.json
Docs: https://www.agenticincome.ai/mcp
Connect (Claude Code): claude mcp add --transport http agentic-income https://www.agenticincome.ai/api/mcp

For the current inventory use MCP tools/list or the discovery document above.
Select the source_to_offer prompt to review an offer hypothesis with draft_income_graph,
then call draft_offer_experiment to calculate contribution and export the sourced brief.
A human supplies the price and variable cost assumptions and approves all external actions.
Open the tool's JSON at /workbench/offer-brief to edit it or export Markdown.

## What this site is

- Three operator income models — services, products, systems — with honest
  time-to-first-dollar ranges, labor profiles, and failure modes.
- A partner-program registry with commission rates, cookie windows, and
  verification dates. Disclosure: some links are affiliate links routed via
  go.agenticincome.ai; Agentic Income may earn a commission. The honest pick
  wins even when there is no payout route.
- Products with honest status: the free Starter Kit is delivered on-site today;
  paid products (Blueprint $67, Private Intel $19/mo, and pack editions) show
  their real gated status until checkout is live. Nothing is purchasable that
  the catalog does not mark for sale.
- Free MCP tools stay free; any paid capability will be announced on the
  catalog, never enabled silently.

Key pages: /mcp · /tools · /start · /offers · /trust · /disclosure
Expanded discovery: https://www.agenticincome.ai/llms-full.txt

## Network

Sister sites, distinct disciplines:
- agenticpassiveincome.com — systems that run without you (automation-first),
  with its own MCP server at https://www.agenticpassiveincome.com/api/mcp
- disruptivepassiveincome.com — portfolio/compounding doctrine

Site: https://www.agenticincome.ai · Author: Frank Riemer

## Public economics API

Read dated market observations at /api/v1/economics?dataset=markets and supply costs at
/api/v1/economics?dataset=costs. Each row links to its source. The OpenAPI contract is
https://www.agenticincome.ai/economics.openapi.json. The same evidence is available
through search_digital_economies and list_supply_costs on the MCP server.
